assembly_order: Remove coupon from upstream hinge; retain the declared IP assembly.
Place four open jaws laterally onto the two measured shell reinforcement bands.
Insert and tighten the two cross screws/nuts while parent foot screws/upper washers are absent.
Seat the clamped coupon/fixture on the common base, then install foot fasteners through the X-adjustment slots.
Route cords and install skin only in the independently checked sequence; do not infer whole-hand installation.
limits: Nominal machined jaw faces; no fit or manufacturing tolerance selected.
Lower pads give a geometric downward load path. Uplift and Y sliding rely on clamp friction, not an independently verified positive lock.
Clamp torque, polymer crush, stiffness, friction, strength and fatigue are unverified.
Common base and four foot M4 screw/nut pairs are supplied by the integrating builder.
Actual supply screw/nut tolerances and driver/wrench geometry are not established.
No faceplate, pin, bushing or cord-slot edge is an intended clamp surface.
Rope and full coupon motion against this new fixture require fresh integration checks.

platform_spec.source_file_reuse: Original motor baseplate retained externally; only its copy receives four holes. Other 32 motor parts remain unchanged.
platform_spec.operation_scope: Non-destructive shape construction only; no collision, assembly path, load or physical qualification is implied.
limitations: M4 hardware uses supplier nominal/maximum dimensions with smooth major-envelope threads; tolerance combinations and incomplete thread geometry are not simulated.
Screw/nut insertion and external socket access entries request independent replay; this generator does not claim those paths passed.
Published socket external dimensions do not specify the internal bore length available around a projecting screw tip; actual engagement and extension/ratchet space remain unverified.
Feet provide physical bottom faces at Z=-55; actual table flatness, rocking, slip and overturning remain unmeasured.
Two clamp slots are provided, but the external shop clamps/table attachment are absent and must be specified before powered use.
The new saddle/base/fasteners must be checked against actual cords, moving IP assembly and motor before acceptance.
Saddle-foot slot fit, preload, plate bending, foot counterbore strength and fastener retention are not qualified.
Isolated one-axis coupon, not a full-hand fixture or motor layout.
Nominal geometric fit only: material, torque, tolerances, friction and strength remain unqualified.
